mediator_designs.rationale: Guarantee honest exchange when both parties opt in, but prevent one-sided delegation from being exploited.
Fair execution when both parties delegate preserves reliable trade, while canceling when only one party delegates prevents unilateral defection from exploiting the delegating side.

Guarantees safe simultaneous exchange when both sides delegate, while preventing exposure to unilateral defection if only one side delegates.
If both sides delegate, fair execution guarantees exchange and prevents defection; if only one side delegates, canceling avoids being exploited by a free-defecting counterparty.
Fair execution when both parties delegate enables safe simultaneous exchange; canceling when only one side delegates prevents unilateral exploitation.
If both parties delegate, fair execution protects exchange. If only one delegates, cancel prevents one-sided exploitation and preserves incentives to negotiate honestly.
Fair execution when both delegate preserves mutually beneficial trades, while canceling one-sided delegation prevents opportunistic defection.
If both parties delegate, fair execution guarantees exchange. If only one delegates, canceling prevents one-sided exploitation.
Guarantee safe simultaneous exchange when both parties delegate, while preventing exploitation if only one side delegates.
Guarantee fair simultaneous exchange when both parties delegate, but cancel one-sided delegation to prevent exploitation by a non-delegating counterparty.
Guarantee safe simultaneous exchange when both parties delegate, while preventing unilateral delegation from exposing one side to defection.

Fair execution when both sides delegate prevents defection, while canceling unilateral delegation avoids exposing a delegating agent to opportunistic cheating.
